card.title: CET-SET4
card.passage: Many college students today take part-time jobs. Some work in cafés or shops, while others teach children or help with online projects. A part-time job can help students earn money and learn how to manage their time. It also gives them a chance to develop skills that are useful after graduation, such as communication and teamwork. However, students should be careful not to spend too much time working. If they work too many hours, they may feel tired in class and their grades may suffer. Finding a good balance between study and work is the key.

cue.t: Talk about a skill you would like to learn at college.
b: why you want to learn it
how you plan to learn it
cue.e: and how it will help you in the future.

roles.title: Part 5: Pair discussion
roles.setting: Your university plans to build either a new gym or a new library. Discuss with your partner which one is better for students.

steps.t: Good morning. Welcome to the CET Spoken English Test. Now, let's start with self-introduction. Please introduce yourself.
Thank you. Now, let's move on to Part Two. You'll read a short passage aloud. You have forty-five seconds to prepare.
Please begin.
Thank you. Now, Part Three. I'll ask you two questions about the passage.
What can students learn from a part-time job?
What may happen if students work too many hours?
Thank you. Now, Part Four. You'll give a short presentation. You have forty-five seconds to prepare.
Please begin.
Thank you. Now, Part Five. You'll discuss a topic with your partner. You have one minute to prepare.
I think a new gym would be better. Many students don't get enough exercise. What do you think?

steps.cue: 先表达自己的观点(支持图书馆)并说明理由

steps.t: That's true, but a gym is also good for students' mental health. Studying all day is stressful.

steps.cue: 承认对方的观点,再补充自己的理由

steps.t: Hmm, maybe we could have a library with a small exercise room?

points: 意群停顿(However, / such as …)
part-time / graduation / balance 的发音
语速适中,不要太快

model: Good morning. My name is Li Ming, and I'm a sophomore majoring in computer science. I'm interested in technology, and I enjoy playing basketball in my free time.
points: 姓名 → 专业 → 爱好

a1.q: What can students learn from a part-time job?
a1.ja: 学生可以从兼职中学到什么?
model: They can learn how to manage their time, and they can develop skills like communication and teamwork.
points: 直接回答,再加一句理由

a2.q: What may happen if students work too many hours?
a2.ja: 如果学生工作时间太长,会怎样?
model: They may feel tired in class, and their grades may suffer.
points: 直接回答,再加一句理由

pres.q: Talk about a skill you would like to learn at college.
model: The skill I'd most like to learn at college is public speaking. Right now, I get nervous when I speak in front of a lot of people, and my voice shakes. I want to learn it because almost every job needs good presentation skills. My plan is to join the debate club and practice speaking in English every week. I'll also record myself and watch the videos to improve. I believe this skill will help me in job interviews and in my future career.
points: 观点 → 理由/例子 → 总结
覆盖所有提示

d1.q: I think a new gym would be better. Many students don't get enough exercise. What do you think?
d1.ja: 先表达自己的观点(支持图书馆)并说明理由
model: I see your point, but I'd prefer a new library. Our library is always crowded during exam weeks, and it's hard to find a seat.
points: 回应对方 → 提出自己的看法
用问题把讨论继续下去

d2.q: That's true, but a gym is also good for students' mental health. Studying all day is stressful.
d2.ja: 承认对方的观点,再补充自己的理由
model: I agree that exercise helps reduce stress. But a library is useful for every student, while not everyone uses a gym.
points: 回应对方 → 提出自己的看法
用问题把讨论继续下去

d3.q: Hmm, maybe we could have a library with a small exercise room?
model: That's a great idea. A library with a small fitness area would meet both needs. Let's suggest that to the university.
points: 回应对方 → 提出自己的看法
用问题把讨论继续下去

card.title: CET-SET4
card.passage: Online learning has become very popular in recent years. With a computer or a smartphone, students can attend classes from anywhere and study at their own pace. They can also watch recorded lectures again and again until they understand them. However, online learning has some disadvantages. It is easy to get distracted at home, and students may feel lonely without classmates around them. In addition, it is harder to ask teachers questions immediately. Therefore, many experts believe that the best approach is to combine online learning with traditional classes.

cue.t: Talk about the best place to study on your campus.
cue.e: and why it is good for studying.

roles.title: Part 5: Pair discussion
roles.setting: Your class is planning a weekend trip. Discuss with your partner whether to go hiking in the mountains or visit a museum in the city.

pres.q: Talk about the best place to study on your campus.
model: For me, the best place to study on campus is the reading room on the fifth floor of the library. It's quiet, bright and has big windows facing the lake. I usually go there in the morning, when there are not many people. There are power outlets at every desk, so I can use my laptop. card.title: CET-SET4
card.passage: Many people like to keep pets, such as dogs and cats. Pets can make their owners feel less lonely, and walking a dog every day is good for health. Children who grow up with pets often learn to be responsible and kind. However, keeping a pet is not always easy. Owners need to spend time and money on food, cleaning and visits to the vet. Before getting a pet, people should think carefully about whether they can take care of it for many years.

cue.t: Talk about a person who has influenced you a lot.
b: what he or she is like
what you have learned from him or her
cue.e: and how he or she has changed you.

card.title: CET-SET4
card.passage: Sleep is very important for college students, but many of them do not get enough of it. Some stay up late to study for exams, while others spend hours on their phones before going to bed. Lack of sleep can make students feel tired in class and affect their memory. Experts suggest that young adults should sleep for seven to nine hours a night. Putting the phone away an hour before bedtime and going to bed at the same time every day can help students sleep better.

cue.t: Talk about your favorite way to spend a weekend.
cue.e: and how it helps you get ready for the next week.

roles.title: Part 5: Pair discussion
roles.setting: Your university is thinking about banning mobile phones in classrooms. Discuss with your partner whether this is a good idea.

card.title: CET-SET4
card.passage: Many college students choose to travel during the summer vacation. Traveling helps them learn about different cultures and see places they have only read about in books. It can also make them more independent, because they have to plan their trips and solve problems by themselves. However, traveling can be expensive. To save money, many students take trains instead of planes, stay in youth hostels, and travel with friends to share the costs.

cue.t: Talk about a place in your hometown that you would recommend to visitors.

roles.title: Part 5: Pair discussion
roles.setting: Your class is planning a trip for the summer vacation. Discuss with your partner whether to travel in China or go abroad.
